Stage 1 Input: PyTorch reference tensor program - KNGraph/TBGraph API or MPK layer ref
Stage 2 Search: incremental uGraph gen - kernel/block exhaustive - thread fusion patterns
Stage 3 Prune+Verify: abstraction pruning - canonical forms - Z3 probabilistic equivalence check
Stage 4 Transpile: uGraph to CUDA (or Triton/NKI) - layout opt - cuDNN/cuBLAS/cuTLASS hooks
Stage 5 Deploy: NVCC JIT binary - integrate into PyTorch - run optimized custom kernels
